Request semantics: Versioned envelope; namespace; source hash; adapter/clock metadata; scoped idempotency key
Authoritative outcome: 202 only after batch and durable job recorded; import status reports record outcomes
Failure / retry behavior: Duplicate same key+digest returns same result; changed payload with same key is a conflict.
No fabricated all-success status for partial ingestion.

Actor and purpose: Crew self or assigned care role
Authoritative outcome: Bounded projection: attention, freshness, evidence, next actor, revision
Failure / retry behavior: Unauthorized subject remains inaccessible; missing measurements stay unavailable.

Authoritative outcome: Raw and canonical values, method, time basis, source locator and quality
Failure / retry behavior: Never resolve silently to latest when an exact historical revision was requested.

Actor and purpose: Authorized data reviewer or permitted self-context correction
Request semantics: Expected revision/If-Match; reason; corrected fields; idempotency key
Authoritative outcome: New revision plus dependent-results invalidation in one domain transaction
Failure / retry behavior: Stale revision yields conflict; preserve both proposed corrections for review.

Authoritative outcome: Persisted review episode with current revision

Failure / retry behavior: Model has no permission to invoke authorization transition.

Failure / retry behavior: Timeout/cancel/invalid output cannot change clinical state.

Authoritative outcome: Draft minimal packet; no outbound send
Failure / retry behavior: Server rechecks field-level scope. AI text remains editable draft.

Request semantics: If-Match draft revision; recipient; purpose; reviewed payload hash
Authoritative outcome: Immutable approved packet and outbox intent committed together
Failure / retry behavior: Changed source/draft or revoked permission blocks release.

Failure / retry behavior: Receipt cannot set clinically reviewed; mismatched packet hash is rejected.

Request semantics: Received packet/revision; signed-in actor; review result
Authoritative outcome: Separate clinically-reviewed event and follow-up disposition
Failure / retry behavior: A replayed transport receipt cannot impersonate clinical review.
